summary: Iteration 21 fully verified. Backend 5/5 tests PASS: POST /api/inventory/serials/bulk-update accepts {ids,tipo?,assigned_to_user_id?} — tag-only update, assign (status->assegnato), unassign via empty string (status->in_stock), and 403 for technician. POST /api/notes/{id}/unsync restores scaricato serials to assegnato/in_stock, clears downloaded_note_id, sets note.synced=false, returns unsynced count. Frontend flows all PASS. (A) UNDO ESPLETATO on WR 17467961: undo-espletato-<wr> button correctly ABSENT in limbo state; after clicking status-espletato-<wr>, ESPLETATA badge appears and undo-espletato button becomes visible; clicking undo removes the ESPLETATA badge, hides the undo button, and shows toast 'Espletato annullato — nota tornata normale'. (B) WAREHOUSE BULK: created 3 test serials via UI, wh-bulk-bar appears with '2 selezionati' when 2 rows selected via wh-select-<serial>. Tag update via wh-bulk-tag-input + wh-bulk-apply-tag → toast '2 seriale/i aggiornati (tag)' and both rows show TEST_UI_TAG in Tag column. Assign via wh-bulk-assignee dropdown (Tecnico Test) + wh-bulk-apply-assign → toast '2 seriale/i aggiornati (assegnazione)'. Unassign via value __none__ → rows show 'Non assegnato' and status 'IN STOCK'. Bulk delete button (warehouse-bulk-delete) inside wh-bulk-bar deletes selected serials — toast '3 seriale/i eliminati' and rows removed. All 3 test serials cleaned up.
action_items: Minor / leftover state: WR 17467961 has cpe='TESTCPE_ITER20_001' left from previous iteration's UI test (backend restored, UI test did not). Warehouse also contains a leftover serial 'TESTCPE_ITER20_001' from iter20 tests. Consider cleaning up if needed.
Nice-to-have: when the note has no cpe/ont_sfp, the auto-sync path on Espletato is silently skipped (no SYNC ✓ badge). The undo flow still works correctly (unsync returns 0 with 200).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js is still ~3150 lines — recommend splitting NoteCard, WarehousePage, InstructionsPage into separate modules.
bulk-update endpoint applies tag change even to 'scaricato' serials but skips assignment change — intentional per spec, but consider documenting in API response (e.g. return skipped_ids).
undoEspletato swallows unsync errors silently (empty catch block). If /unsync fails but the note is already reverted to limbo, user has no feedback. Consider toast.warning on unsync failure.

bulkAssign uses empty-string 'assigned_to_user_id' to indicate unassign; a more explicit contract (e.g. dedicated field or explicit null via Optional[str] with a sentinel) would reduce ambiguity — currently relies on 'is not None' check on server.
